snippet.title: Stream Rapids – Turn your Twitch chat into a boat race
snippet.description: Stream Rapids is a free browser game for streamers: your chat types !play and races down a new river every round. No download, just add one link to OBS. Viewers without Twitch join by scanning a QR code, and Party Mode puts the race on a big screen for parties and classrooms. Play free: https://streamrapids.com
